records.public_claim_text: Vaccines, thimerosal and autism spectrum disorder The Global Advisory Committee on Vaccine Safety reviewed all evidence from 2010 – 2025 regarding a potential link between vaccines and autism, and concluded that vaccines do not cause autism, reinforcing the conclusion from multiple reviews between 2002 and 2012.

records.public_claim_text: WHO Global Surveillance and Monitoring System Launched in 2013, the WHO Global Surveillance and Monitoring System is a cornerstone of WHO’s global response to substandard and falsified medical products, enabling countries to share verified information, identify emerging risks and support coordinated regulatory action across borders, underpinning WHO Medical Product Alerts and global communications.
